_note: Frame budget for npm run check:frames (scripts/measure-frames.mjs). Targets set 2026-11-18 from the owner's brief: about 60 fps at 1x CPU, at least 30 fps at 4x CPU throttling, no long task over 50 ms while scrolling. Measured on an Apple M3 with the real GPU (--use-angle=metal), 1440 x 900 at DPR 2, working mode (panels on). presented fps counts frames the compositor actually swapped, which catches GPU-bound drops that rAF timing misses. Idle presented fps is 28, not 55, because the working sky deliberately renders at 30 fps (renderBudget.js MODES.working); page responsiveness is held by the median rAF limit. Known gap: at 4x CPU the scroll still shows up to 5 long tasks (longest 75 ms, measured 2026-11-18 with three repeats); the 4x trace attributes them to browser rendering of the large page (style recalc, hit testing, Chrome overlay detection), not app script, so the 4x scroll allows 6 while 1x stays at 0. Tighten it when chapters stop rendering off screen. Do not loosen a limit without recording why in the pull request.
